record.question: Winner of the Carol Burnett Award at 2020 Golden Globe awards in Los Angeles
record.explanation: Answer D: Ellen DeGeneres. The Hollywood Foreign Press Association announced on 4 November 2019 that Ellen DeGeneres would receive the 2020 Carol Burnett Award, ahead of the 5 January 2020 ceremony. Thus the recipient was already known by the paper’s December 2019 date; the stem describes the upcoming 2020 awards retrospectively, but Ellen (option (d), index 3) is uniquely supported. Reference: https://goldenglobes.com/articles/ellen-degeneres-to-receive-the-2020-carol-burnett-award/; https://goldenglobes.com/video/carol-burnett-award-ellen-degeneres/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
